name: Amram
bio: Amram is the son of Kohath of the tribe of Levi, husband of Jochebed, and father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam (Exodus 6:20). Scripture records little about his own deeds, but it was he and Jochebed who, under Pharaoh's decree to wipe out Hebrew baby boys, still brought children into the world and risked their lives to preserve Moses, the future leader who would bring Israel out of Egypt — making their family an essential link in the history of Israel's redemption.
